name: deploy-03 / Circumstance
description: An EU change freeze is in force.
effect_on_significance: Approval must also check the freeze calendar.

name: loto-03 / Circumstance
description: The press being shut down carries an accumulator retrofit.
effect_on_significance: Shutting down no longer removes stored hydraulic energy.

name: loto-05 / Resource
description: Padlock inventory runs short at the north station.
effect_on_significance: Shared locks break the one-person-one-lock rule the step exists for.

name: loto-06 / Performer
description: On nights a deputy, not the safety officer, verifies zero energy.
effect_on_significance: The verification becomes the only independent check on the isolation.
